summary: Mostly not: most Ultimate Oscillator settings did the same as random on BTC, ETH and SOL. One long result holds: on 4h, entries while UO(7,14,28) was below 30 beat random by 3.71% after 20 candles, and downtrend entries carry it. On 1h the short side ran the other way: after UO went above 70, price kept rising, and shorting there did 0.47% worse than random.

verdicts.text: Beat random by 3.71% after 20 candles, and the gap holds without its strongest stretch. It shows at 10 and 20 candles only, and in uptrends there were too few episodes to judge.

verdicts.use: Buying oversold on 1h (below 30 or crossing up 30)
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, whether as a level below 30 or as a cross up through 30. BTC alone looked worse than random, but only because of one stretch.
Worse than random by 0.47% after 20 candles, because price kept rising after readings above 70. On 4h and daily the same setting did the same as random.
Worse than random on 1h and 4h, but each result rests on signals on Jan 2-4, 2021. Without them it is the same as random.
Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily, even though it is by far the most frequent signal.

notes: On 4h, UO(7,14,28) below 30 gave 92 entries in 56 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 3.71% ahead of random entries, above a luck band of -2.12% to 2.62%. The gap holds without its strongest episode and shows at 10 candles too, but not at 50 or 100. No single coin had enough episodes to be judged on its own.

Downtrends carry this 4h result. Entries made while the pair was below its 200-day SMA beat random by 4.2%, and that holds without their strongest episode, on Dec 1, 2025. Uptrend entries came to only 21 episodes, too few to judge. So on 4h this result says nothing about uptrends.

The 4h cross up through 30 beat random by 2.69%, but that gap rests on one entry on Nov 4, 2020. Without it, the result is the same as random. The cross up through 35 on 4h landed inside the luck band at 0.93%.

On 1h, oversold readings did the same as random. Below 30 gave 899 entries and finished 0.36% behind random, inside the band. BTC alone looked 0.74% worse than random, but only because of signals on Jun 12-14, 2022, around the Celsius withdrawal freeze. On 1h the cross up through 35 beat random by 0.26% in downtrends, at 10, 20 and 50 candles. In uptrends it showed nothing.

Shorting while UO was above 70 on 1h did 0.47% worse than random, over 1,942 entries in 731 moves. It holds without its strongest stretch, on Jan 2-3, 2021, and shows at 10 and 100 candles. Uptrends carry it: 0.63% worse than random at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles, while in downtrends it was the same as random. Readings above 70 marked strength that continued, not tops.

Below 30 on 4h fires rarely, with 92 entries against 899 for the same level on 1h. So it suits a long DCA bot as a filter beside other conditions, not as the only trigger. Its lead fades by 50 candles, so a take profit sized to fill within about 20 candles matches what price did. It breaks in uptrends, where the data is too thin to judge. On a short bot, leave UO above 70 on 1h out in uptrends: price kept rising after it.
